entries.description: Hosted Duvo MCP server card, listed in the official MCP Registry as io.github.duvoai/duvo. Approved workspaces use it to start runs and respond to approval gates before write-back. The MCP endpoint is https://api.duvo.ai/v2/mcp.
representativeQueries: audit all carrier invoices against the freight contract before we pay
find overcharges on supplier invoices before the payables run
run grocery inbound exceptions across WMS and ERP and ask for approval before write-back
connect to the Duvo MCP server to start a freight audit run

entries.description: Duvo agent discovery manifest. It lists capabilities, auth, OpenAPI, MCP, and the A2A card for freight audit, payables audit, and grocery or retail work across WMS, ERP, and TMS.
representativeQueries: discover Duvo agent capabilities and authentication
where is the Duvo OpenAPI spec and MCP server card
how does an agent connect to Duvo for payables audit

entries.description: Duvo A2A agent card. It describes operational runs, case queues, and human approval before write-back into the systems of record the business already runs.
representativeQueries: Duvo A2A card for freight audit with human approval
hand a retail OTIF dispute to Duvo for write-back to the TMS
route a payables exception through Duvo case queues

entries.description: Live OpenAPI for the Duvo public API. Clients use it to start runs, create queue cases, and inspect outcomes after write-back.
representativeQueries: create a Duvo API case for a freight overcharge claim
approve a Duvo human request before write-back to ERP
inspect a completed Duvo payables audit run

entries.description: Index of public Duvo skills on this host: duvo-cli, duvo-job-debugger, and duvo-sop-writer.
representativeQueries: install the Duvo CLI skill to script runs and approvals
debug a failed Duvo freight audit job from the transcript
write a Duvo SOP for payables audit across ERP and supplier portals
